note: Fixed before any policy training or evaluation. contact_n was calibrated from the proposed 0.05 N to 0.01 N before freezing because the 10 g pen weighs 0.098 N, so resting support on four fingertips is about 0.025 N per finger.
simulator: Isaac Lab 2.3.2 / Isaac Sim 5.1 PhysX, official Sharpa Wave right hand USD (sharpa-urdf-usd-xml 0d447b6)
physics: nominal: gravity 9.81, friction 1.0 x U(0.9, 1.1), pen mass nominal x U(0.85, 1.15); simplified presets are reported separately and never count
final_seeds: 41100000-41100099, unused until a policy is frozen
final_target: at least 95 of 100 trials pass every numerical check, plus visual review of complete videos

added_checks.reason: Stricter only; nothing above was loosened. The user flagged a flat finger in the best candidate: its ring finger never touched the pen (0% contact, zero joint speed) while the 2-of-3 participation rule still passed.

all_fingers.rule: each listed finger needs >= min_active_s of active contact (touching and its joint RMS speed > active_joint_speed_rad_s, during forward rotation) in at least min_revolutions of the 3 revolutions
